2024-01-20
Claim opened for a left-turn collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck by an oncoming vehicle at an
intersection. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
2024-04-12
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver involved is listed as a named driver, with coverage active at the time of
loss. Nothing in the file suggests the vehicle damage predates the start of coverage.
2024-05-01
Police report obtained, and it places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact. Statements from two
independent witnesses match the described sequence of events.
2024-06-01
Scene photographs and the other driver's account both confirm the collision occurred as reported. Vehicle damage is
largely consistent with the described impact, though the impact appears to have been light.
2024-06-02
Medical records received showing a wrist fracture. The injury is severe relative to the low-speed contact visible in the
photos, and the reported mechanism does not readily explain it.
2024-06-16
Records show the treatment followed a typical course, with care tapering as the claimant's condition improved. No
prior injury to the same wrist or arm appears in the available history.
2024-07-11
The claimant has given the same account of the accident in each conversation with the adjuster and through counsel.
No inconsistencies have been noted to date.
2024-08-11
Reviewed the vehicle's prior claim history and found no earlier damage on record. Preliminary repair estimate is being
compared against the photos for further review.
2024-08-19
File is pending a final evaluation of the injury claim against the medical records and the light-impact findings. Counsel
has been notified that a decision on the bodily injury portion will follow the review.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
